test_policy.notes: Catalog and international page: high school applicants do not need to submit an SAT or ACT score for most undergraduate programs but may choose to; some programs may require one. A competitive SAT or ACT score can also serve as English proficiency for freshman applicants.

requirements.notes: Apply on Detroit Mercy's own application or the Common App. International freshman checklist: high school transcript, 250-word essay on any topic, one letter of recommendation (guidance counselor or teacher), bank statement showing funds for the first year, Statement of Financial Support form if the account is a sponsor's, and a passport copy. The Common Data Set (2024-25) says Detroit Mercy has no application fee; the admissions pages do not mention a fee. Some programs have earlier deadlines or extra requirements (5-year Physician Assistant and 7-year Dental: January 15).

deadlines.label: Early Action (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Non-binding. The international page gives 'Early Action: November 1' with no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. The catalog says early action applicants are notified by December 1.

deadlines.label: Scholarship priority deadline
deadlines.notes: Applicants by this date are considered first for scholarships (catalog).

deadlines.label: Regular/rolling admission deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Decisions are released as applications are completed; the international page urges applying early because of visa time. The Common Data Set also lists March 1 as the closing date and December 1 as the priority date.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required for admission to most programs, but proficiency must be shown before classes start: citizenship of an English-official country, a degree from a U.S. or English-medium institution, a minimum test score, or (freshmen only) a competitive SAT or ACT score. Students without a qualifying score take an English placement test on arrival; those who do not pass must enroll in the American Language and Culture Program (ALCP) and may have to defer the start of classes a semester or more. ALCP classes do not count toward full-time status for scholarships. Nursing applicants must have TOEFL iBT 83 (4 on the new scale) on file before a decision.

english.notes: Paper-based minimum 550. Nursing 83. Some older catalog pages (2024-25) list iBT 80; the 2026-27 catalog and the admission page say 81.
The international page gives '4 in the new scale' alongside the 81 iBT minimum; nursing also 4 (83 on the old scale).

aid.notes: International freshmen who enroll full-time (and pass the English requirement) receive a Detroit Mercy scholarship of up to $10,000 per academic year based on cumulative high school GPA; it is renewable and cannot be combined with other university grants. Canadian freshmen can also earn a $1,000 Visit Grant. International students are not eligible for federal or state aid. In the Common Data Set (2024-25 est.), 126 degree-seeking undergraduate nonresidents received institutional aid averaging $18,443, which is above the published $10,000 scholarship cap, so other awards may exist; the aid page describes no need-based aid for international undergraduates.

cost.notes: 2026-27 full-time on-campus cost of attendance for business, humanities, health professions and science: tuition $34,276, housing and food $11,502, books $1,468, transportation $1,190, personal $3,146, loan fees $72 = $51,654. Architecture and engineering tuition is $35,498 (total $52,876). No separate international tuition rate is published

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the Detroit Mercy admissions pages.
